acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce identical inline and multiline literal t.Run claim extraction using exact source and binary identities.
Either support inline source without widening authority or state the admitted syntax boundary explicitly with a focused regression.
Retain expected versus actual producer/link evidence and distinguish missing capability from intentional unsupported syntax.
body: Observed capability gap, suspected defect pending contract adjudication. Unreleased combined Corvint candidate built from reviewed leaf29902ae5 plus root staged wiring: a valid single-line Go TestOCMLinkFixture containing literal t.Run("TM-V0-008 exact anchor", func...) refused the correct normalized claim selector with claim-selector-out-of-range. Reproduction: /private/tmp/corvint-wow-combined-use-riwq0ht_/fixture and its ocm-link argv/stderr. Identical source formatted as the existing multiline fixture linked successfully at /private/tmp/corvint-wow-combined-use-9iz0dhxj/fixture. Expected behavior needs owning OCM contract adjudication; do not infer all Go formatting is supported. Distinct from V1-0275 numeric-selector normalization (read and retained), which explains the earlier incorrect-selector refusal. No installed release defect is claimed.
title: OCM: qualify or document extraction of inline Go t.Run literals
